scripts.build: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.tool-config ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.tool-config ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate:local: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.tool-config wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.worker:dev: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.tool-config ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.tool-config wrangler dev --config dist/server/wrangler.json --persist-to .wrangler/state --port 8787
